sleeve.puff_classic_main.description: Classic puffed cap sleeves in main dress color
sleeve.puff_classic_main.contents: Cap sleeves with extreme puffed gathering at shoulders in massive sculptural volume. Elasticated cuffs at upper arm defining puff shape. Sleeves match main dress color.

sleeve.puff_classic_accent.description: Classic puffed cap sleeves in accent color
sleeve.puff_classic_accent.contents: Cap sleeves with extreme puffed gathering at shoulders in massive sculptural volume. Elasticated cuffs at upper arm defining puff shape. Sleeves in attire accent color.

sleeve.bubble_main.description: Bubble cap sleeves in main dress color
sleeve.bubble_main.contents: Bubble cap sleeves with rounded dome puff at shoulders. Gathered elastic cuffs at upper arm defining bubble shape. Sleeves match main dress color.

sleeve.bubble_accent.description: Bubble cap sleeves in accent color
sleeve.bubble_accent.contents: Bubble cap sleeves with rounded dome puff at shoulders. Gathered elastic cuffs at upper arm defining bubble shape. Sleeves in attire accent color.

sleeve.segmented_main.description: Segmented puff cap sleeves in main dress color
sleeve.segmented_main.contents: Segmented puff cap sleeves with 3-4 separate rounded poufs across shoulders. Each puff individually shaped. Poufs decrease in size from shoulder outward. Sleeves match main dress color.

sleeve.segmented_accent.description: Segmented puff cap sleeves in accent color
sleeve.segmented_accent.contents: Segmented puff cap sleeves with 3-4 separate rounded poufs across shoulders. Each puff individually shaped. Poufs decrease in size from shoulder outward. Sleeves in attire accent color.

sleeve.balloon_main.description: Balloon cap sleeves in main dress color
sleeve.balloon_main.contents: Balloon cap sleeves with massive rounded puff volume at shoulders. Gathered elastic cuff at upper arm defining balloon volume. Sleeves match main dress color.

sleeve.balloon_accent.description: Balloon cap sleeves in accent color
sleeve.balloon_accent.contents: Balloon cap sleeves with massive rounded puff volume at shoulders. Gathered elastic cuff at upper arm defining balloon volume. Sleeves in attire accent color.

sleeve.tiered_ruffle_main.description: Tiered ruffle cap sleeves in main dress color
sleeve.tiered_ruffle_main.contents: Cap sleeves with 3-4 horizontal ruffle tiers. Each tier 2-3cm width. Ruffles cascade from shoulder to upper arm. Sleeves match main dress color.

sleeve.tiered_ruffle_accent.description: Tiered ruffle cap sleeves in accent color
sleeve.tiered_ruffle_accent.contents: Cap sleeves with 3-4 horizontal ruffle tiers. Each tier 2-3cm width. Ruffles cascade from shoulder to upper arm. Sleeves in attire accent color.

sleeve.theatrical_volume.contents: Massive ruffle sleeves with 15-20cm projection from shoulders. Multiple ruffle layers creating sculptural cloud effect. Extreme theatrical volume.

sleeve.enormous_puff.contents: Massive puff sleeves gathered from shoulders. Sleeves puff enormously with volume concentrated at shoulder and upper arm. Exaggerated sculptural form.
